page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU configuration allocates exactly 1.0 thread per core, providing dedicated physical execution units without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for workloads requiring hardware acceleration. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps. The system does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge offers a high density of dedicated physical cores and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, which is suitable for enterprise workloads that require predictable CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core resource contention. Appropriate workloads for this profile include general-purpose application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-sized database deployments that rely on network-attached storage.
